## 📉 Performance Issue

What kind of issue are you seeing?
- [ ] FPS drops below target
- [ ] Frame stutter / hitches
- [ ] Battery drain
- [ ] Long load times
- [ ] Memory crash
- [ ] Thermal throttling

## 📊 Profiler Snapshot

Run `Window → Analysis → Profiler` and attach screenshot showing:
- CPU Main thread time
- Render thread
- GC Alloc spikes
- Draw calls / triangles
- Memory usage

## 🎮 Scene / Action When Issue Occurs

What were you doing? (e.g. "Mining in cave", "Boss fight", "Multiplayer with 10 players")
